description: Witness cases for tasks/pretty-name-parity-deferred.md — a DEFERRED cluster derived from the same last-25-commits analysis of the JVM Thunderduck (nubank/thunderduck) that produced the sqlwrap cluster, specifically the neighbourhood of PR #55 (092a616a35, 'Preserve source column name for bare Cast'). PR #55 itself does NOT reproduce in τ: it is a deliberate divergence FROM Spark (renames bare col(c).cast(T) to c), whereas τ's analyzer::pretty_name already matches Spark's toPrettySQL for a bare Cast (CAST(c AS T)) and ensure_named forces that alias into emission — so a bare-cast projection is GREEN against the Spark oracle. But the analysis surfaced a REAL adjacent gap in the same unaliased-projection auto-naming family: pretty_name's own doc-comment states that CaseWhen / windows / subqueries / complex-type literals keep the Thunderduck-boundary fallback name 'expr'. Every existing cond-*/win-* case aliases its projection, so this path is untested. When such a projection is unaliased, τ names the output column 'expr' while Spark names it via toPrettySQL; the differential _compare_schemas flags the column-NAME mismatch → red. All entries have "deferred": true — born RED and EXPECTED TO STAY red until pretty_name renders these shapes with Spark parity. They are NOT in select_block_corpus_baseline.txt, so their redness is not a regression. Goldens were RE-RECORDED from live Apache Spark 4.1.1 (2026-07-15, Linux devcontainer) and are authoritative (Spark stamps '__autoGeneratedAlias' metadata on these columns); regenerate via `THUNDERDUCK_WORKTREE_ROOT=/workspace run-differential-tests.sh --record core -k prettyname`. Verified born-red 2026-07-15: τ names the column 'expr' vs Spark's toPrettySQL name (schema name mismatch); the differential compares row multisets order-insensitively, so a no-orderBy case is red purely on the name.

witnesses.pins: unaliased when/otherwise — τ names col 'expr'; Spark 'CASE WHEN (age >= 40) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END' (pretty_name CaseWhen fallback)
unaliased chained when — τ 'expr'; Spark 'CASE WHEN (age < 30) THEN 0 WHEN (age < 45) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END'
unaliased when WITHOUT otherwise (nullable) — τ 'expr'; Spark 'CASE WHEN active THEN salary END'
unaliased window row_number — τ 'expr'; Spark 'row_number() OVER (...)' — second fallback shape (windows) from the same pretty_name boundary
